newsitem.title: UK: English China Clays sees further cost cuts.
newsitem.headline: English China Clays sees further cost cuts.

text.p: English China Clays Plc said further cost cuts were needed in its U.S. and European operations, following an ongoing strategic review.

ECC said in a statement with results the strategic review had "highlighted the need for significant cost reduction in the U.S. and European operations over and above the cost reduction initiatives which have been in hand." ECC saw pretax profits crumble to 5.7 million stg in the six months ending June 30 from 55.3 million stg previously but maintained its interim dividend at 5.5 pence per share.
It took an 18.6 million stg provision as a result of the review in relation to certain under-performing assets in Europe, the Pacific and Brazil.
It said the drop in profitability in the first half was due to a fall in demand for minerals from the paper industry and high level of costs of a semi-fixed nature.
Manufacturing problems in the U.S. had also been a factor in the slide, the company said.
It said trading conditions since June had not been "significantly different from the first half."
ECC said in paper, "the position is mixed, depending on market segment."
The company is seeing signs of improvement in performance minerals in Europe and steady performance in North America.
Worldwide ceramics also continue to perform steadily.
In addition, ECC is seeing benefits from the cost cutting initiatives taken in the first half.
ECC it would base a decision on a final year dividend on the outcome of the review and the trends in trading.
